decisions.reason: Although submarine interior lighting is relatively distant from the core range, it still fits the firm's maritime customer base and, for a large expanding R&D-active firm, the option value of learning in this niche likely outweighs short-run pressure to exit.

A medical examination light extends the firm's lighting capabilities into an adjacent professional application, so with little evidence yet that uncertainty has resolved negatively, management would likely keep the option open.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires strongly build on the firm's established industrial offer and engineering strengths, making this product line a promising adjacent option that is unlikely to be abandoned quickly.

The designer task light is close to the existing offer and was relaunched as a popular product, so its demonstrated market relevance and limited strategic risk make continued retention the more likely choice.
